640:t_1:169.en:
$$甲児$$
「These two are as lovey-dovey as ever, too!」

640:t_1:170.en:
$$さやか$$
「We can't let them outdo us, $$甲児$$.」

640:t_1:171.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's how it is, everyone! Everyone in the Volunteer Club is doing great!」

640:t_1:173.en:
$$宗介$$
「I promise! We'll all graduate together!」

640:t_1:176.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I think your expressions are still a little stiff...」

640:t_1:177.en:
$$クラン$$
「Especially you, $$宗介$$! How many times do I have to tell you to smile!?」

640:t_1:178.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not an actor. I can't smile simply because someone tells me to.」

640:t_1:179.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd known this would be such a hassle, I'd have found a way to visit $$陣代高校$$...」

640:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「You say that, $$千鳥$$... but we've all been busy with our own work this past month. We simply didn't have the time.」

640:t_1:181.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Especially you, $n. You and the other $$リアクター$$s were helping Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others with their research the whole time.」

640:t_1:182.en:
$n
「So sending a video letter instead was a good idea, but I never imagined we'd have this much trouble...」

640:t_1:183.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... This is getting so tiresome. Why don't you just put on that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ suit?」

640:t_1:184.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's a shame... If I'd brought it, I could at least have won Captain $$クラン$$ over.」

640:t_1:185.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait... Where did you leave that thing?」

640:t_1:186.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's in a locker in the Volunteer Club's room.」

640:t_1:187.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I have no regrets. I'm sure whoever finds it will use it to protect the peace at school.」

640:t_1:188.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't sow the seeds of chaos when daily life has finally calmed down!」

640:t_1:189.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$! We should strive for lasting peace through mutual understanding...」

640:t_1:190.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't think I'll ever understand you!」

640:t_1:191.en:
$$クラン$$
「OK! We got a great shot!」

640:t_1:193.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes, yes! You're much better when you're being yourselves!」

640:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Th-then what was the point of all our hard work through take 27...?」

640:t_1:197.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$! You haven't forgotten your promise to treat me to galactic ramen, have you!?」

640:t_1:198.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$風間$$! I got that first issue of 'Manly Super Robots Monthly' you wanted! You've got something to look forward to!」

640:t_1:199.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$! Are you working hard on your entrance exam prep!?」

640:t_1:200.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll be there for graduation, too! Let's all go to karaoke again!」

640:t_1:202.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But don't treat us like your odd-job service the second we show up!」

640:t_1:203.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We do things besides picking up trash, you know.」

640:t_1:204.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$大貫$$, I'm sorry I haven't kept in touch. Hire me again when I get back!」

640:t_1:205.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Is everyone doing well? It's $$西条涼音$$, your former student teacher.」

640:t_1:206.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n and I are doing well, too! I'm... $n and I are both looking forward to seeing everyone again!」

640:t_1:207.en:
$n
「H-hold on, Miss $$スズネ$$! You're making way too much of a point of that!」

640:t_1:208.en:
$$ボス$$
「Hahaha! Too bad, boys, myself included!」

640:t_1:209.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Apparently those two got together somewhere along the way!」

640:t_1:213.en:
$n
「Hey! What are you saying, Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

640:t_1:214.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The cool, wild, mysterious $n you all knew is dead!」

640:t_1:215.en:
$$宗介$$
「What we've got here is an idiot who got a girlfriend even though he can't read the room!」

640:t_1:218.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The power of love is infinite, after all.」

640:t_1:219.en:
$$甲児$$
「These two are as lovey-dovey as ever, too!」

640:t_1:220.en:
$$さやか$$
「We can't let them outdo us, $$甲児$$.」

640:t_1:221.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's how it is, everyone! Everyone in the Volunteer Club is doing great!」

640:t_1:223.en:
$$宗介$$
「I promise! We'll all graduate together!」

640:t_1:225.en:
$$アスカ$$
「If you're going to stand there staring wistfully, why don't you go hang out with the Volunteer Club?」

640:t_1:226.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't... go back to being one of them anymore...」

640:t_1:229.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm just... a little lonely, that's all.」

640:t_1:230.en:
$$カヲル$$
($$シンジ$$... I believe the day will come when your feelings are rewarded...)

640:t_1:233.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well... I can't find Big Sis anywhere...」

640:t_1:234.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now that you mention it, I haven't seen her today...」

640:t_1:235.en:
$$ノノ$$
「D-don't tell me Big Sis got our departure date wrong and went off somewhere to have fun...!」

640:t_1:238.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You knew about this, Big Sis!?」

640:t_1:239.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ラルク$$ came to me for advice and asked me to keep it quiet.」

640:t_1:240.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why, Big Sis $$カズミ$$!? Has Big Sis stopped liking $$ノノ$$!?」

640:t_1:241.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's not it, $$ノノ$$... But what $$ラルク$$ needs now is time to think on her own.」

640:t_1:242.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And $$ラルク$$ has decided how to put her abilities to use.」

640:t_1:244.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I haven't heard the details, either... But she'll be the key to this fleet...」

640:t_1:246.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then Big Sis is coming with us, too, isn't she?」

640:t_1:247.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I just heard from her. Apparently she'll be leaving after we do.」

640:t_1:248.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If $$ノノ$$ can still see her again out in the galaxy, $$ノノ$$ will go ahead, clear a path for Big Sis, and wait for her.」
